_about: Shared settings for every eval run (AGENTS.md: one config file both adapters read). Behavioural fields feed settings_hash; prices and paths do not.

clock._about: The frozen time is the seed's 'now' (eval/seed/seed.json); this is its named zone.

endpoint._about: Both harnesses call the local LLM relay, which forwards to Azure OpenAI's v1 API. Origin and key come from these environment variables, read by the relay only.

gpt-4.1-mini._prices_source: OpenAI/Azure list price for gpt-4.1-mini; confirm against the Azure bill

gpt-6-luna._api_why: Azure rejects function tools with a reasoning effort on /chat/completions for this model (decided 2026-09-28)
gpt-6-luna._prices_source: Azure price list for gpt-6-luna, short context (requests up to 272K tokens), given by the user on 2026-10-04. Long context (over 272K) is 0.20 / 0.02 / 0.25 / 0.75. The largest single request in the Luna dev runs was 42K tokens, so the short-context prices apply.

graph.context_injection: appended to every agent's system prompt (supervisor + 4 workers), after a blank line
graph.checkpointer: fresh InMemorySaver, new thread per run

hermes.context_injection: ephemeral_system_prompt (appended to the system prompt after a blank line)

judge._about: LLM judge for ambiguous/impossible tasks (eval/grade/judge.py). Chosen 2026-09-28: GPT-6 Luna, the strongest model on the Azure resource. No tools, so chat completions accepts its reasoning effort. Calibrate against ~20 hand labels (target >= 80% agreement).
